verdict.rationale: SigNoz has an API that service accounts can call, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probe returned 404 on every candidate path. Service-account API access, the MCP server and Agent Skills are adjacent capabilities, not an explorable API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
